Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on if the count is between 1-3 and either (1) object1 is present, or (2) object1 is absent with exactly 2 objects of any type or exactly 3 objects all even-indexed (including object0) or all odd-indexed (excluding object1).

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on if the count is 1-3 and either (1) object1 is present with 1 or 2 objects (regardless of type), or (2) object1 is absent with exactly 2 objects of any type or exactly 3 objects all even (including object0) or all odd (excluding object1).
